ownership.5yr_cost_note: Quote Audi Care prepaid maintenance up front; it usually beats pay-as-you-go by a meaningful margin.
ownership.reliability_note: Watch for carbon buildup on direct-injection engines past 70,000 miles and keep up with DSG fluid service on the S tronic.

sales_objections.objection: The screen is smaller than the competition.
sales_objections.response: It is, but look where Audi put the resolution: the 12.3 in virtual cockpit gives you full-width navigation right behind the wheel, where your eyes already are. Screen size on the console matters less than where the information sits.

sales_objections.objection: It is built in Mexico, not Germany.
sales_objections.response: San Jose Chiapa was built new for the Q5 and it feeds the global market, not just North America - the same plant supplies Europe. Audi's own quality audits treat it identically to Ingolstadt.
The honest answer is that they need their maintenance done on schedule - miss services and costs spike. That is why I want to quote Audi Care into your payment, so the first 50,000 miles are handled.

The X3 is the sportier chassis - I will not argue it. The Q5 is the better daily companion: quieter, more comfortable, and quattro is standard where BMW charges for xDrive on some trims. Drive both on the same route.

talk_tracks: Lead with standard quattro - it removes an entire upcharge conversation rivals have to have.
Demonstrate the virtual cockpit with Google Earth navigation; it is the strongest in-car wow moment in this class.
Slide the rear bench during the walkaround to show the cargo/legroom trade for families with strollers.
data_disclaimer: Figures are approximate US-market values for demo purposes. Verify against the manufacturer window sticker before quoting a customer.
